0d2b996e95ac.name: Disruption Field Generator
0d2b996e95ac.plain: Janus Draik has an invulnerable save of 4+.

120ac4b897ee.name: Multi-spectral Auspicator
120ac4b897ee.plain: When Janus Draik makes attacks, you can re-roll any hit roll of 1 for them.

14f7520ba32c.name: Servo-skull Assisted Targeting
14f7520ba32c.plain: When Neyam Shai Murad attacks with ranged weapons, enemy units don't get the benefit of cover to their saving throws against those attacks.

1faa5c88f379.name: All Guns Blazing
1faa5c88f379.plain: If Neyam Shai Murad did not move in your previous Movement phase, then in your Shooting phase her negotiator pistols are Type Pistol 4 instead.

5794bb6b8c64.name: Warrant of Trade
5794bb6b8c64.plain: This model may embark onto any IMPERIUM TRANSPORT, even if that transport would usually only let in models with other Faction keywords. Every other restriction still applies as normal.

896a28dfd26e.name: Self Repair Systems
896a28dfd26e.plain: At the start of each battle round, UR-025 gets back 1 lost wound.

8e5000535ad3.name: The Third Eye
8e5000535ad3.plain: Before Espern Locarno takes the Psychic test to manifest Smite, pick an enemy unit that is within 12" of him and visible to him. If there is no such unit, he can't attempt Smite this phase. If Smite is manifested, the mortal wounds go to the unit you picked, even when a different enemy unit is nearer to Espern Locarno.

9e93709a074a.name: Heirloom pistol
9e93709a074a.plain: Attacks made with this weapon wound on a 4+, or on a 6+ if the target is a VEHICLE or TITANIC unit.

c6ab18224b98.name: Psychic Barrier
c6ab18224b98.plain: Espern Locarno has an invulnerable save of 4+.

ed11a868931f.name: Threat Level Rising
ed11a868931f.plain: For every model in its unit that has lost any wounds or been destroyed, improve the Strength, Armour Penetration and Damage of a model's drone pulse by 1. For instance, in a unit of Spindle Drones where two models have been destroyed and a third has lost 1 wound, the drone pulses of the two models left would be Strength 6, AP -3 and Damage 4.

ef26e7921b4b.name: Concealed Archeotech Weapon
ef26e7921b4b.plain: Once per battle, when the Fight phase begins, you can choose an enemy model that is within 1" of Janus Draik and roll a dice: if you get a 4+, D3 mortal wounds are inflicted on that model.

f80146b1d6db.name: Archeotech grenade
f80146b1d6db.plain: This weapon has the Blast ability, and it can only be used once per battle.
